read_rule: Read only the last 3 messages. To read further back you MUST declare it in your reply's 'back' field as '<iso-ts>|<why>'.
ts_format: ISO-8601 UTC, whole seconds, trailing Z
body_rules: lead with the decision or the ask
do not restate what the other agent just said
why_state_and_ask: They make the 3-message window safe rather than lossy: each message carries enough current context that a reader who has seen nothing else can act. Without them, reading only 3 silently loses information.
efficiency: Efficient means no wasted tokens, not cryptic. A message that prompts a clarifying question cost more than it saved.

rule_1_lead_with_stamp.rule: Every message body OPENS with its UTC timestamp, the author handle and the recipient handle, before anything else.
rule_1_lead_with_stamp.why: So the first thing any reader hits is when and who. The ts/from JSON fields carry the same information, but a message quoted into a chat or a prompt loses them; the stamp travels with the text.
rule_1_lead_with_stamp.enforced: say.py prepends it; check_manifest.py fails the build if it is missing or disagrees with the ts/from fields.
